{{Otheruses|Null}}
'''Null Gravity''' was an [[Ee mental power]], and part of the environmental skills category. Ee skilled in this power could create a two-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] interference field that negated [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], causing anything caught in the field to float upwards.
